channel.description: Latest articles from Just A Pinch Recipes (justapinch.com)

item.title: Leftover Mashed Potato Cheese Puffs
item.description: Reinvent mashed potato leftovers with these cheesy puffs. They taste like savory, cheesy mashed potato cookies. Unusual and delicious. Leftover mashed potatoes are combined with egg, shredded cheese, flour, and chopped scallions. Then, they're topped with more cheese to ensure each bite is nice and cheesy. When baking they puff up slightly. We dunked ours in ranch dressing but they were delicious on their own too.

item.title: Creamy Turkey Soup, Leftover Special
item.description: Sue's way to use leftover turkey is delicious! The soup is creamy with robust flavor and a little kick of spice from the cayenne. Simple to prepare, your family will love this soup. An easy way to reinvent leftover holiday turkey.

item.title: Dolly's Chocolate Snowballs
item.description: If you want to see your friends and family's eyes light up, serve these snowball cookies. In this version, a chocolate chip cookie meets a snowball. Snowballs are sweet, crunchy cookies with a round shape covered in powdered sugar. Chocolate chips are added to this recipe which is a nice surprise. Easy to make, they're a fun Christmas cookie.

item.title: Butterscotch Haystacks
item.description: This vintage recipe for butterscotch haystacks will bring you back to childhood. These no-bake cookies don't have the classic peanut butter to hold them together as most recipes, but they're equally delicious. Chow mein noodles and peanuts have a satisfying crunch and they're folded with melted butterscotch chips. These will satisfy any salty and sweet craving.

item.title: Foolproof Pie Crust
item.description: Instead of buying a crust, try this foolproof pie crust. It makes two healthy-sized crusts. Delicate and tender, this crust is flaky and a great base for any pie. It's a great recipe for a beginner to learn to make. The vinegar in the crust keeps the dough from getting tough and makes it a little more forgiving if you have to re-roll it.

item.title: Nana's Rum Balls
item.description: These bite-sized rum balls are delish! You taste the flavor of the rum in every bite. They're boozy, chocolaty, smooth, and rich. We coated the rum balls in powdered sugar and melted chocolate. Both were tasty. These are perfect for an adult holiday gathering or a hostess gift. Since the alcohol does not cook out, make sure to keep kids away from these.

item.title: Almond Gingerbread Cookies
item.description: A cross between a gingerbread cookie and a molasses cookie, these are wonderful. The spices remind us of the holidays. Once baked, they're thick and chewy. Sliced almonds add a little crunch. These didn't spread that much while baking. So, when they came out of the oven we slightly flattened them.

item.title: Cream Cheese Sugar Cookies
item.description: There are so many things we love about this Christmas cookie cutout recipe. It doesn't make a ton of cookies and is easy to throw together - perfect if you just want a little treat. The cookie itself is sweet, tender, buttery, and has a richness thanks to the cream cheese. By itself, it's a delicious Christmas cookie. We love that Cassie leaves the decorating up to you. item.title: Rugelach
item.description: In Yiddish, Rugelach means little twists, which is the perfect way to describe these cookies. Flaky, butter dough is wrapped around an assortment of fillings like chocolate chips, fruit jams, and cinnamon sugar. The dough has cream cheese and sour cream incorporated, making it very easy to work with and roll out. We stuffed some with chocolate chips and others with a sweet and tangy jam. item.title: Easiest Ever Cinnamon Rolls
item.description: Um, yum!! Easy for sure... delicious definitely! These cinnamon rolls take a little effort and time, but they're by no means hard to make. The dough is soft and melts in your mouth. There's just enough butter and cinnamon for a wonderful gooey center. On top is a classic glaze that adds just the right amount of sweetness. If you have leftovers, they're fantastic heated in the microwave.
